cli.compatibility: Production mode, option meaning, channel behavior, and exit-code classes are stable in v1; diagnostic mode names remain available while their human-readable formatting is not frozen.

c_abi.compatibility: ABI-major-1 symbols and sealed records are immutable; extensible root records grow only by tail fields and sized initializers.

cpp_api.delivery: header-only facade over the C ABI
cpp_api.compatibility: Source compatibility is preserved within stable v1; hosts link only to the narrow C shared library.

machine_result_protocol.name: mparser.result
machine_result_protocol.compatibility: Major 1 preserves existing field meaning and spelling; additive optional fields require a minor revision.

builtin_source_contract.compatibility: Major 1 freezes descriptor and call/result semantics as a source-integration contract, not C++ object layout or an external plugin ABI.

versioning_and_deprecation.compatibility: Stable v1 elements remain supported throughout v1.x; deprecations document a replacement and remain until the next major release.

cmake_package.metadata: Engine, C ABI, C++ source API, CLI, machine protocol, builtin source contract, license, and installed contract-document locations.

required_for: production or diagnostic CLI mode and option changes
public C symbol or record changes
public C++ declaration or behavior changes
machine protocol field or exit-channel changes
ownership, lifetime, concurrency, diagnostic, or error-contract changes
rules: Classify the change as compatible, additive, deprecated, or breaking.
Add old-client or protocol-golden evidence before updating a frozen hash.
Increment the applicable revision, minor, or major before shipping changed semantics.
Do not remove a stable v1 contract before the documented deprecation window.
